name: MonarchSelect
title: Select
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox with a read-only androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField anchor, ExposedDropdownMenu and androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenuItem
summary: A labelled field that picks one value from a short, fixed list through a menu, with group headings, descriptions, disabled options, helper and error text.
whenToUse: For one choice among a handful of known options (a region, a size, a role) where the options do not need to be visible all the time.
whenNotToUse: For a long list or one the person searches use MonarchCombobox. For two to five options that should stay visible use MonarchRadioCardGroup or the Material 3 SegmentedButton. For several values use MonarchCheckboxGroup or MonarchTagInput.
api: @Composable fun <T> MonarchSelect(options: List<MonarchSelectOption<T>>, selected: T?, onSelect: (T) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, label: String? = null, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, contentDescription: String? = null, initiallyOpen: Boolean = false)
class MonarchSelectOption<out T>(value: T, label: String, description: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, group: String? = null)

options.name: options
options.description: The options in order: value, label, description, enabled and group. Consecutive options with the same group share a heading.

options.name: selected
options.description: The value of the chosen option, or null for no choice yet.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Called with the value of the option the person chooses; the menu closes.

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label, which floats into the outline.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Choose an option", shown in the muted color while nothing is chosen.

options.name: errorText
options.description: The error message; replaces the helper text and is set as the field's error.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the menu can be opened.

options.name: contentDescription
options.description: The TalkBack name when there is no visible label.

states.name: nothing chosen
states.description: The field shows the placeholder in the muted text color.

states.name: chosen
states.description: The field shows the chosen label in the default text color.

states.name: open
states.description: The Material 3 menu lists the options under their group headings; the chosen one has a filled radio mark and is selected.

states.name: disabled option
states.description: Listed in the disabled color and cannot be chosen.

states.name: error
states.description: The danger outline and label, and the message under the field.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The disabled colors; the menu does not open.

appearance: The field uses MonarchTextField's colors: a surface fill with the input border, the focus ring when focused, the danger strong color in error. The menu is the Material 3 menu on the surface color; group headings and descriptions are muted text; the chosen option's radio mark is the accent strong color and others the input border. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web's Select is a Radix listbox with its own trigger, typeahead and sm, md and lg sizes; iOS uses the system menu Picker and ships no type. Android ships MonarchSelect because Compose has no select control: it is the Material 3 exposed dropdown with a read-only field, which keeps the expand action, menu focus and placement. There is no size option (the field is MonarchTextField's size) and no typeahead in the menu. Separators are replaced by group headings. The web's required mark is not offered; put the field in a form that states it, or use MonarchFormField around another control.
accessibility: The field is the Material 3 exposed dropdown anchor: TalkBack reads the label, the chosen value or placeholder, and the expand state, and double tap opens the menu.
Every option is a menu item read with its label and description; the chosen option is marked selected and also has a filled radio mark, so the choice does not rely on color.
Group headings are headings; disabled options are disabled.
The error is the field's error semantics and is shown as text with a danger outline.
The field is at least 48dp high, the menu items are Material 3 items of 48dp, and text scales and wraps at large font sizes.
edgeCases: A selected value that is not among the options shows the placeholder.
Two options with the same value are both marked selected; give each option a distinct value.
Options with the same group that are not next to each other get two headings.
A long label wraps in the menu; in the field it stays on one line.

examples.title: Status picker
examples.template:
MonarchSelect(
    options = listOf(
        MonarchSelectOption({{options.0.value}}, {{options.0.label}}),
        MonarchSelectOption({{options.1.value}}, {{options.1.label}}),
        MonarchSelectOption({{options.2.value}}, {{options.2.label}}),
    ),
    selected = status,
    onSelect = { status = it },
    placeholder = {{label}},
    initiallyOpen = true,
    modifier = Modifier
        .width(224.dp)
        .semantics { contentDescription = {{label}} },
)
examples.code:
MonarchSelect(
    options = listOf(
        MonarchSelectOption("open", "Open"),
        MonarchSelectOption("pending", "Pending"),
        MonarchSelectOption("resolved", "Resolved"),
    ),
    selected = status,
    onSelect = { status = it },
    placeholder = "Status",
    initiallyOpen = true,
    modifier = Modifier
        .width(224.dp)
        .semantics { contentDescription = "Status" },
)

examples.title: Values of any type
examples.code:
MonarchSelect(
    options = listOf(5, 10, 25).map { MonarchSelectOption(it, "$it seats") },
    selected = seats,
    onSelect = { seats = it },
    label = "Plan size",
)
